package: @astryxdesign/core

# DropdownMenuCheckboxItem

An independently checkable option inside DropdownMenu. The row owns menuitemcheckbox semantics while the shared Indicator supplies decorative checkbox paint.

Anatomy: Checkable row, Label/content, Checkbox marker

## Import

```tsx
import { DropdownMenuCheckboxItem } from '@astryxdesign/core/DropdownMenu';
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `label` | `ReactNode` | - | Primary label text identifying the item. |
| `description` | `ReactNode` | - | Secondary description text displayed below the label. |
| `icon` | `IconType` | - | Icon to display before the label. See `astryx docs icons` for valid semantic names. |
| `value` | `boolean` | - | Whether the item is checked. Controlled; pair with onChange. |
| `onChange` | `(checked: boolean) => void` | - | Callback fired with the next checked state when the item is toggled. |
| `isDisabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether the item is disabled. A disabled item stays in the accessibility tree as disabled (aria-disabled), and the arrow keys and typeahead reach it so keyboard users find it. The pointer highlight skips it, and activation is blocked. |
| `hasCloseOnSelect` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether toggling the item closes the menu. Checkbox items default to staying open so several can be toggled in a single session. |
| `ref` | `React.Ref<HTMLElement>` | - | Ref forwarded to the row root, the element carrying role="menuitemcheckbox". Register the row with an element-keyed observer or overlay. |
| `endContent` | `ReactNode` | - | Content to render after the label and description, such as a keyboard shortcut hint or badge. |
